description: A terminal window is open in the Muncie HEC-RAS project directory. The project contains completed simulation results in an HDF5 file. Python analysis and visualization scripts are available in the ~/Documents/analysis_scripts/ directory. Your task is to generate a flood hydrograph plot showing water surface elevation over time for the Muncie flood simulation. Find the appropriate plotting script, determine how to use it (check its --help output or read the script to understand its arguments), and run it against the simulation results HDF5 file. The plot should be saved as a PNG image in ~/Documents/hec_ras_results/. The resulting plot should display the flood wave pattern at a representative computational cell.
